results.title: Unlocking the power of AI in CRM
results.content: Unlocking the power of AI in CRM: A comprehensive multidimensional exploration Khadija Khamis Alnofeli * , Shahriar Akter , Venkata Yanamandram School of Business, University of Wollongong, NSW 2522, Australia A R T I C L E I N F O JEL classification: M31 O32 O33 Keywords: AI-powered CRM capabilities Microfoundations of dynamic capabilities Data management Multichannel integration Service offerings A B S T R A C T Artificial intelligence (AI) is revolutionising customer relationship management (CRM) across various sectors, fundamentally altering strategic business operations. While the pandemic reinforced the importance of incorporating advanced technological in-novations into customer management systems (Shin & Kang, 2020), a critical gap remains in terms of understanding and optimising AI-powered CRM capabilities (Chatterjee et al., 2023). AI-powered CRM platforms integrate advanced analytics and robust data management practices, which has revolutionised customer service and operational efficiency across industries such as banking, healthcare, hospitality, airlines, retail and many others (Chiang, 2019; Jha, 2022; Kumar et al., 2023; Omoge et al., 2022; Tal´ on-Ballestero et al., 2018; Wang & Hajli, 2017).
